component.value: An export still running after one hour has already crossed the duration threshold.

component.value: Separating queue wait, worker execution, object-read and upload timing is proposed to identify where additional time accumulates, where comparable trace spans exist.

component.value: Missing trace spans represent missing evidence, not evidence of zero delay.

coverage.non_warrant_content: P001 identifies the ordered deployment history and suspected-onset search scope; it does not assert that an onset or transition has been verified. The enumerated planning and recording items in P004 and P006 remain grouped within their protocol requirement and stated rationale rather than becoming separate claims for each noun.

Sequencing language and references to the current midpoint, endpoints and remaining history organize the procedure. Its substantive conditions, measurement choices, restrictions and outcome relations are captured in the claims; routine iteration wording adds no separate proposition.

The observation and phase lists identify the contents of the proposed measurements. Their individual nouns are not independent claims; their measurement roles, evidentiary distinctions and diagnostic purpose are captured together.

Boundary and intervention references connect the follow-up steps to the localization procedure. Deployment choices, prerequisites and evidence bounds are captured without supplying missing operational thresholds or resolving the alternative-branch ambiguity in P026.

P033 is a reporting instruction to disclose gaps and inconclusive endpoints; it does not assert that particular gaps or inconclusive endpoints have occurred. Lists of possible confounders and complications remain grouped by their stated effects rather than being split into claims for every listed factor.
